svg.aria-label: The package proxy: an apt index is revalidated against the origin and streamed to the host while cached; a package file is fetched once per key and streamed; a Mac's pkg is fetched by digest and committed only if the digest matches.
svg.title: Package proxy: index, pool file and pkg by digest
svg.desc: A client on the lab LAN asks the coordinator for an apt index, a package file or a pkg by digest. The coordinator answers from its cache directory when the entry is fresh or immutable, and otherwise fetches from the public origin once per key, streaming to the client while it writes a temporary file that is renamed into place. The pkg is committed only when its SHA-256 equals the digest in the path. The client verifies signatures and digests itself.
svg.text: Package proxy: an apt index, a pool file, and a Mac's pkg by digest
Host's apt, daemon, or a Mac
lab LAN, no client certificate
Coordinator, package proxy
public-CA name, port 443
Cache directory
tmp/ and objects/ on one filesystem
Origin, public internet
packages.komira.ai, GitHub releases
1. GET /apt/komira/dists/stable/InRelease
2. entry older than the index TTL: conditional GET
3. 304, or 200 with the body
4. body to tmp, fsync, rename
5. streamed with the length, never held whole
6. GET /apt/komira/pool/main/x.deb
7. lookup: miss
8. one origin fetch per key; later askers wait
the body is streamed to the first asker while it is written; a waiter reads the committed file; a failed fetch lets the next waiter try
9. GET /pkg/<sha256>.pkg (a Mac)
10. only a digest named in installs; redirects: https, few
11. hash while writing; rename if equal
12. streamed; on a mismatch, 502, nothing kept
the proxy is untrusted: apt checks the Release signature, the daemon the digest and attestation, the Mac the pkg signature
cache full or disk error: the answer is still streamed from the origin, nothing is stored, a counter in Status says so
